## Files

All in `metacode/`. Never edit `generated/`.

| File | Holds |
|---|---|
| `models.yaml` | Models and enums. The reserved `state` model types state.yaml. |
| `state.yaml` | `state:` initial values, validated against the `state` model. |
| `ui.yaml` | `widgets:` map of id -> widget. The entry is the `initial` route of navigation.yaml (else `homePage`). |
| `navigation.yaml` | Routes (pages, bottom sheets, dialogs) actions open with `core.navigator`. Optional. |
| `style.yaml` | Design tokens: colors (light/dark), fonts, type, radius, spacing. Optional keys; see [Style](#style). |
| `actions/*.dart` | `Future<void>` functions that change the state with `emit(StateDelta(...))`. |
| `bindings/*.dart` | Functions that return a value for the UI. |
| `test/*_test.dart` | Tests through `app.<function>(...)` (see `test/fixtures.dart`). Actions are async: `(await app.addTask(s)).tasks`; `app.emitted`, `app.navigation`, `app.requests` record the last action and `app.api = (method, url, body) => ApiResponse(...)` fakes the api. |

## Types

In `models.yaml`:

| Type | Dart | state.yaml value |
|---|---|---|
| `string` | `String` | `"text"` |
| `boolean` | `bool` | `true` / `false` |
| `number` | `num` | `3`, `2.5` |
| `datetime` | `DateTime` | `2026-11-05` or `2026-11-05T10:30:00` |
| `list(t)` | `List<T>` | a YAML list |
| `t?` | `T?` | may be omitted or `null` |
| a model name | its class (`task` -> `Task`) | a map of its fields |
| an enum name | its enum (`filter` -> `Filter`) | one of its values |

```yaml
task:                 # model -> class Task
  title: string
  note: string?
  tags: list(string)
filter: [all, open, done]   # enum -> enum Filter
state:                # reserved -> class State
  tasks: list(task)
  filter: filter
```

Generated classes have mutable fields, a named-parameter constructor (`Task(title: ..., tags: [...])`) and `copyWith(...)`. Import them with `import '../generated/state.dart';`.

## Actions and bindings

```dart
Future<void> actionName(State state, [void Function(StateDelta) emit], [Core core], [int index], [<type> value])
T bindingName(State state, [int index])   // returns a value for the UI
```

```dart
Future<void> addTask(State state, void Function(StateDelta) emit) async {
  state.tasks.add(Task(title: state.draft));
  emit(StateDelta(tasks: state.tasks, draft: ''));   // only what changes
}
```

- The first parameter is always `State`. Others are matched **by name**:
  - `emit` (`void Function(StateDelta)`, actions only): applies a `StateDelta`. Call it as often as needed (loading, then result).
  - `core` (`Core`, actions only): `core.api` and `core.navigator`, see below.
  - `index` (int): position of the item inside a `listView`/`gridView` `itemBuilder`
  - `value` (String | bool | num | int | double): the new value from an input (see each widget's notes for its type)
- Actions never return a state. `StateDelta` (generated next to `State`) has every State field, all optional; set only the ones that change. Top-level fields are replaced whole, so for a list or model, change `state`'s copy and emit it (`StateDelta(tasks: state.tasks)`). A delta can't set a field to null.
- `state` is a fresh copy taken when the action starts; it does not see its own emits.
- Bindings return a primitive, a model, an enum, or a `List` of those (nullable allowed).
- Names must be unique across all actions and bindings. Private helpers start with `_`.

## Core: api and navigator

Import `../generated/core.dart`.

```dart
Future<ApiResponse> core.api.get(String url, {Map<String, String>? headers})
Future<ApiResponse> core.api.post(String url, {Object? body, Map<String, String>? headers})  // non-String body is sent as JSON
ApiResponse: int status, String body, bool ok, dynamic json   // network error: status 0

Future<void> core.navigator.push(Routes.settings)   // completes when the route closes
Future<void> core.navigator.pop()                   // closes the page, sheet or dialog on top
```

```dart
Future<void> loadRate(State state, void Function(StateDelta) emit, Core core) async {
  emit(StateDelta(loading: true));
  final r = await core.api.get('https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/USD');
  final rate = r.ok ? ((r.json as Map)['rates'] as Map)['BRL'] : null;
  emit(StateDelta(loading: false, rate: rate is num ? rate : 0));
}
```

Don't await `push` when the action should keep going while the route is open.

### navigation.yaml

```yaml
initial: home                        # must be a page
routes:
  home: homePage                     # page (shorthand); the value is a ui.yaml widget id
  settings: {page: settingsPage}
  rate: {bottomSheet: rateSheet}
  confirmDelete: {dialog: confirmDeleteDialog}
```

- Each route becomes a constant: `Routes.rate`. Sheets and dialogs size to their content and scroll if long; give them padding.
- Tab-style screens inside one page stay as state + `match` (see below); routes are for things that open on top.

## ui.yaml

```yaml
widgets:
  homePage:            # entry point
    scaffold:
      appBar: {title: "Notes"}
      body: noteList    # -> the widget with id noteList
  noteList:
    listView: {data: notes, itemBuilder: noteTile, empty: "No notes"}
  noteTile:
    listTile: {title: noteTitle, onTap: openNote}   # binding, action
```

- A widget is a map with **one key**, its type: `text: {...}`.
- A string node is: a widget id, else a binding (its value is shown as text), else literal text.
- Widget ids must not equal a binding or action name.
- Some widgets have a shorthand (shown below): `column: [a, b]`, `expanded: child`, `text: "Hi"`.
- Widgets with no required props are written with an empty map: `divider: {}`.

Prop kinds:

| Kind | Accepts |
|---|---|
| `node` | a widget id, a binding, an inline widget, or literal text |
| `nodes` | a list of nodes |
| `cases` | a map of value -> node |
| `action` | name of an action |
| `binding` | name of a binding |
| `value` | a binding name or a literal |
| `literal` | a literal (number, text, list, map) |
| `icon` | an icon name (see Icons) |
| `color` | a color (see Colors) |
| `inline` | another widget's properties, written inline |

## Widgets

**Layout**: `scaffold`, `appBar`, `column`, `row`, `stack`, `wrap`, `expanded`, `spacer`, `center`, `padding`, `sizedBox`, `container`, `card`, `scroll`, `divider`

**Navigation**: `match`, `navigationBar`

**Content**: `text`, `icon`, `image`, `avatar`, `progress`, `listView`, `gridView`, `listTile`, `if`

**Input**: `textField`, `checkbox`, `toggle`, `slider`, `dropdown`, `choiceChip`, `iconButton`, `filledButton`, `outlinedButton`, `textButton`, `elevatedButton`, `floatingActionButton`, `tappable`

### Navigation

#### `match`

Shows the case matching a binding value (e.g. the current page). Falls back to `default`.

| Prop | Kind | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `value` | binding |  |
| `cases` | cases | keys are compared to the value as text (enum names work) |
| `default` | node |  |

#### `navigationBar`

Bottom navigation. Put it in `scaffold.bottomBar`.

| Prop | Kind | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `destinations` | literal | list of {icon, label} |
| `selected` | binding | binding returning the selected index (int) |
| `onSelected` | action | gets `value` (int): the tapped index |

## Icons

[Phosphor](https://phosphoricons.com) icons, in the weight set by style.yaml `icons.weight`. The selected tab of a `navigationBar` shows the filled form.

`add`, `remove`, `edit`, `delete`, `close`, `check`, `done`, `clear`, `search`, `settings`, `home`, `person`, `people`, `favorite`, `favoriteBorder`, `star`, `starBorder`, `share`, `menu`, `moreVert`, `moreHoriz`, `arrowBack`, `arrowForward`, `chevronLeft`, `chevronRight`, `expandMore`, `expandLess`, `refresh`, `info`, `warning`, `error`, `help`, `notifications`, `email`, `phone`, `calendar`, `schedule`, `alarm`, `location`, `map`, `camera`, `image`, `photo`, `play`, `pause`, `stop`, `music`, `shoppingCart`, `payment`, `wallet`, `list`, `grid`, `filter`, `sort`, `bookmark`, `label`, `flag`, `lock`, `visibility`, `visibilityOff`, `inbox`, `send`, `chat`, `attach`, `download`, `upload`, `cloud`, `folder`, `file`, `link`, `logout`, `login`, `lightMode`, `darkMode`, `timer`, `checkCircle`, `radioUnchecked`, `trendingUp`, `barChart`, `fitness`, `restaurant`, `local`, `work`, `school`, `pets`, `flight`, `car`, `trendingDown`, `arrowUp`, `arrowDown`, `arrowUpRight`, `arrowDownLeft`, `piggyBank`, `target`, `receipt`, `coins`, `chartLine`, `bank`, `gift`, `sparkle`, `plusCircle`, `user`

## Colors

`#RRGGBB`, `#AARRGGBB`, or a name. Every name follows style.yaml and light/dark mode, so prefer names over hex. Style tokens first (see [Style](#style)), then Material scheme names derived from them, then hues mapped to the style (`red` = `danger`, `green` = `success`, `blue` = `info`, `orange` = `accent`, `amber` = `warning`, `grey` = `ink3`):

`bg`, `surface`, `fill`, `fillStrong`, `line`, `lineStrong`, `ink`, `ink2`, `ink3`, `primary`, `onPrimary`, `accent`, `onAccent`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `info`, `primaryContainer`, `onPrimaryContainer`, `secondary`, `onSecondary`, `secondaryContainer`, `onSecondaryContainer`, `tertiary`, `onSurface`, `onSurfaceVariant`, `outline`, `error`, `transparent`, `white`, `black`, `grey`, `red`, `green`, `blue`, `orange`, `amber`, `purple`, `pink`, `teal`

## Text variants

For `text.style.variant`. Each is defined in style.yaml `typography:`. In the Metacode style, display/headline/titleLarge use the display face (Newsreader); the rest use the text face. `bodySmall` is secondary text; `label*` are for controls and short labels:

`displayLarge`, `displayMedium`, `displaySmall`, `headlineLarge`, `headlineMedium`, `headlineSmall`, `titleLarge`, `titleMedium`, `titleSmall`, `bodyLarge`, `bodyMedium`, `bodySmall`, `labelLarge`, `labelMedium`, `labelSmall`

## Style

`metacode/style.yaml` holds the design tokens every widget is themed from. Every key is optional: what is missing falls back to the Metacode style (classic and quiet: near-black ink, soft neutral page, white cards, one deep blue accent). Change the look here, not by adding colors and sizes all over ui.yaml.

```yaml
theme: system            # system | light | dark
fonts: {display: Newsreader, text: Hanken Grotesk}
icons: {weight: regular}   # thin | light | regular | bold
colors:
  light: {accent: "#3049C6"}   # any color token
  dark: {accent: "#8C9DF5"}
radius: {sm: 10, md: 14}
typography:
  bodyLarge: {font: text, size: 16, weight: 400, height: 1.5, tracking: 0}
```

Fonts: `Albert Sans`, `Hanken Grotesk`, `Schibsted Grotesk`, `Newsreader`, `Figtree`, `system`.

| Section | Token | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| `colors.light / colors.dark` | `bg` | page background, behind every screen |
| `colors.light / colors.dark` | `surface` | cards, sheets, menus, the navigation bar |
| `colors.light / colors.dark` | `fill` | quiet fill: fields, chips, avatars, containers |
| `colors.light / colors.dark` | `fillStrong` | heavier fill: tracks, pressed states |
| `colors.light / colors.dark` | `line` | hairlines: dividers, card edges in dark mode |
| `colors.light / colors.dark` | `lineStrong` | control borders: outlined buttons, checkboxes |
| `colors.light / colors.dark` | `ink` | primary text and icons |
| `colors.light / colors.dark` | `ink2` | secondary text: labels, captions, subtitles |
| `colors.light / colors.dark` | `ink3` | tertiary text: placeholders, disabled, idle icons |
| `colors.light / colors.dark` | `primary` | the main action fill (filled buttons, checked controls) |
| `colors.light / colors.dark` | `onPrimary` | text and icons on primary |
| `colors.light / colors.dark` | `accent` | progress, the text caret, highlights |
| `colors.light / colors.dark` | `onAccent` | text and icons on accent |
| `colors.light / colors.dark` | `success` | done, positive amounts |
| `colors.light / colors.dark` | `warning` | needs attention |
| `colors.light / colors.dark` | `danger` | destructive, failed, negative amounts |
| `colors.light / colors.dark` | `info` | neutral context |
| `radius` | `xs` | checkboxes, tooltips, small indicators |
| `radius` | `sm` | buttons, fields |
| `radius` | `md` | cards, menus |
| `radius` | `lg` | floating buttons, sheets, dialogs |
| `radius` | `pill` | switches, chips, avatars, progress bars (999 = fully round) |
| `spacing` | `s1` | icon to label inside a control |
| `spacing` | `s2` | tightly related elements |
| `spacing` | `s3` | control padding, list row gaps |
| `spacing` | `s4` | default gutter |
| `spacing` | `s5` | card padding |
| `spacing` | `s6` | section gutter |
| `spacing` | `s8` | between sections |
| `sizes` | `control` | height of buttons and fields (tap target) |
| `sizes` | `icon` | default icon size |
| `sizes` | `border` | hairline and control border width |
| `fonts` | `display` | headlines and large titles |
| `fonts` | `text` | everything read or tapped: body, titles, labels, buttons |
| `typography.<variant>` | `font` | display or text |
| `typography.<variant>` | `size` | font size |
| `typography.<variant>` | `weight` | 400, 500, 600 or 700 |
| `typography.<variant>` | `height` | line height, as a multiple of size |
| `typography.<variant>` | `tracking` | letter spacing, as a fraction of size (-0.02 = -2%) |

Using the style well:

- Hierarchy comes from type, not color: a `displaySmall` number over a `labelMedium` caption beats a colored box.
- Spend color on meaning: `primary` for the main action, `success`/`danger` for outcomes, `accent` rarely.
- Don't nest cards. For lists, prefer rows separated by `divider` over one card per row.
- Gaps from the spacing scale (4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 32). Related things closer, groups further apart.

## Interpreter rules

Actions and bindings run in dart_eval. `tool/check.sh` reports violations.

- Type closure parameters: `tasks.where((Task t) => t.done)`, not `(t) => ...`.
- Don't interpolate ints from `DateTime` getters (`'${d.month}'`). Use `toIso8601String()`.
- Only `dart:` imports and the project's own files.
- All files are bundled together, so private helper names must be unique across files.
